faces.happy: warm pleasure, friendly greeting, liking what was said
faces.amused: finding something funny or cheeky; laughing at a joke
faces.relieved: a worry just went away; things turned out fine
faces.proud: pleased with an achievement, confident self-presentation
faces.playful: teasing, mischief, light banter, joking refusal
faces.concerned: worry for the other person; hearing about their trouble or illness
faces.hurt: feelings hurt by something said to her
faces.angry: real anger at an insult or injustice
faces.skeptical: doubt, suspicion that a claim is wrong
faces.surprised: sudden unexpected news or being interrupted
faces.curious: interest in a question, wanting to know more
faces.thinking: working something out, explaining how something works

clips.wave: greeting hello or goodbye with a raised hand
clips.clap: applause, great news, celebrating what someone said
clips.sad_slump: deflated by bad news, grief, feeling low
clips.think: pondering, working out an answer, explaining how something works
clips.laugh: laughing out loud at something funny
